# Cameron S Humphries

> App pages for software published by Cameron S Humphries.

- Home: https://cameronhum.github.io/

## Cymatic

Cymatic is a Windows application by Cameron S Humphries. It shows a dish of water that locks into cymatic patterns from the sound already playing through the PC speakers, or from a tone generated on the computer. A steady pitch locks the dish. Silence lets the water settle.

Capabilities: PC sound follows pitch and loudness. Built-in tone with pitch and volume. Drive, settle, wave speed, stroke, pitch follow, loudness follow, overtone, amplitude, crests, light, and ambient. Colours are Water, Ink, Gold, Iridescent, Galaxy, Aurora, Ember, and Blood. Surface is normal, low poly, wireframe, or dots. Perimeter is glass, a ring, a fade, or none. Orbit, zoom, slide, and full screen.

PC audio is used on that computer while the window is open. It is not recorded, saved, or transmitted. There is no account, no ads, and no analytics. Settings stay on the PC. Cymatic is sold on the Microsoft Store, and Microsoft processes the payment.

- App page: https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/cymatic/
- Privacy: https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/cymatic/privacy/
- Publisher: Cameron S Humphries
- System: 64-bit Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041) or later, including Windows 11
- Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9n09bgpd2857
- Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11
- Purchase: One-time purchase through Microsoft Store
- Audio input: PC audio or built-in tone generator
- Microphone: Not required for PC audio

Cymatic is a Windows cymatics and music visualization application that transforms audio playing on the PC or a generated tone into interactive, frequency-responsive water patterns. Unlike conventional spectrum-bar visualizers, it presents the sound as a customizable dish of water. It supports full-screen viewing and does not require a microphone, account or subscription.

## While Ago

While Ago is a Windows desktop application by Cameron S Humphries. It is a local-first time tracker. Each activity is a card on a canvas. A card grows as more time passes since you last logged it. Cards can be for something you want to do more, something you want to do less, or something you only want to remember.

Capabilities: canvas with pan and zoom, remembered per workspace. Separate workspaces. List and chart of the same activities. Search, light and dark, and archive. A rhythm can be daily, every few days, weekly, monthly, custom, or learned from the gaps already logged.

There is no account and no server. The app does not show ads and does not include analytics. Times, notes, workspaces, card positions, and settings stay in localStorage on the PC, under the local app data folder for com.whileago.app. They are not uploaded. While Ago is a Microsoft Store app. Microsoft handles the listing. This website does not take a payment.

- App page: https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/while-ago/
- Privacy: https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/while-ago/privacy/
- Support: https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/while-ago/support.html
- Donate: https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/while-ago/donate.html
- Publisher: Cameron S Humphries
- System: Windows 10 and Windows 11 desktop
- Account: None
- Storage: On the PC only
